lunil.server.path.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to a compatible `lunil-language-server` executable. The bundled server is used by default.

lunil.server.trace.description: LSP message tracing written to the Lunil output channel.

lunil.server.maximumRestartCount.description: Maximum automatic restarts after unexpected server termination.

lunil.server.gcHeapHardLimitPercent.description: Managed heap hard-limit percentage passed to the bundled server.

lunil.server.suppressedDiagnosticCodes.markdownDescription: Diagnostic codes (for example `LUA6003`) suppressed by the language server analysis. Suppression applies without restarting.

lunil.hostContractPath.markdownDescription: Path to a versioned Lunil host analysis contract exported by a C++, C#, Unity, Godot, or other host. See **Lunil: Show Virtual Host Contract** to inspect the indexed surface.

lunil.hostContractJson.description: Inline host analysis contract JSON. This takes precedence over hostContractPath.

lunil.workspace.library.markdownDescription: Read-only folders with Lua declaration stubs (`---@meta` files) describing globals and classes injected by a host at runtime (C++, C#, Unity, Godot, game engines). Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Editing stubs takes effect after **Lunil: Reindex Workspace**.

lunil.require.searchPaths.markdownDescription: Directory roots (relative to the first workspace folder) used to resolve `require` strings to modules. A require like `Utils.HttpUtils` resolves to `<root>/Utils/HttpUtils.lua` under the first root that contains it — for example `scripts/client`. Leave empty to require exact module identities. Applies after re-indexing.

lunil.analysis.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of Lua files excluded from workspace indexing and analysis — for example `data/**`, `**/*.data.lua`, or `assets/{configs,tables}/**`. Patterns match workspace-relative paths (`/`-separated); a pattern without a separator matches the file name in any directory. Excluded files are not read into memory and requires that name them resolve as untyped; open one in the editor to analyze it anyway. Matching is case-insensitive.

lunil.analysis.autoDetectDataFiles.markdownDescription: Automatically keep generated data files (very large table literals of keys, strings, and numbers with no functions or control flow) out of workspace indexing. Detected files appear under **Lunil: Show Index Status**; use `lunil.analysis.exclude` to exclude more paths or tighten this automatically.

baseArguments.description: Arguments after the class name are base classes (inheritance factories like `class`).

lunil.analysis.classFactories.markdownDescription: Global functions that define classes: `local X = factory("Name", Base, ...)`. The string-literal first argument names the class, so hover shows the class, member writes (`function X:Method()`) define methods, `X.new()` produces instances, and member lookup walks base classes (subclass overrides win). Set `baseArguments: true` for inheritance factories such as `class` — its arguments after the name are base classes; plain factories like `singleton("Name")` or `defineView("Name")` omit it. Applies after re-indexing.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code UI language.
lunil.locale.markdownDescription: Language for Lunil hover cards, menus, and status messages. `auto` follows the VS Code UI language. Applies without a restart.

lunil.statusBar.showModuleCount.markdownDescription: Show the indexed module count in the Lunil status item once indexing completes. The workspace folder name is shown alongside it.
